gemini.rationale: The evidence slice documents the registrant's buyout of the remaining 50% interest in the co-owned Deadwood facility and a large entity-level net loss driven by impairments. There is no documented evidence of product/process disruption (p4_pathway) or process/organization fracture (p5_pathway) during the outcome window.

grok.rationale: The slice documents no product/process interface disruption: the Deadwood co-owned processing asset was simply bought out to full ownership in Nov 2015 and continued operating with reported throughput and acreage dedication, with no alignment failure described. Likewise no process/organization fracture is documented; the FY2015 $(1,377.8)M net loss and $1,328.2M goodwill plus $223.1M intangible impairments are attributed solely to commodity-price and unit-price declines, not to operations-vs-organization integration breakdown.
